description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LDAPSyncServiceFieldValidationTest' that tests LDAP synchronization, specifically validating LDAP user data such as attribute presence, length constraints, and proper handling of LDAP entries within the LDAPSyncService context. It includes setup for mocked services, LDAP entries with various attribute scenarios, and assertions verifying correct validation logging.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceFieldValidationTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating LDAP user attribute handling during LDAP synchronization, including attribute presence, length constraints, and proper logging of validation issues.

methods.name: testDeleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Test method that mocks LDAP entries with various attribute scenarios, invokes LDAP synchronization, and verifies that validation errors are logged appropriately, and the user collections are processed as expected.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Helper method that creates a mocked EntryCollection object with specified LDAP entries and lookup settings for testing.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Helper method that constructs an array of LDAP Entry objects with various attribute configurations to simulate different validation scenarios.
